tools.name: list_cities
tools.description: List the cities this server covers, with the site that publishes each city's events, the regions covered, how many upcoming events are listed, the earliest and latest upcoming dates, the published languages, and how fresh the data is. Call this first to discover valid city values for the other tools

tools.name: search_events
tools.description: Search verified events in one city. Results are sorted by start date and include the event page, the calendar (.ics) link, the verification date and, where the event page carries one, a booking link. tools.name: event_details
tools.description: Return the full record for one event: the long description, every booking link its page carries, the stay link where present, and the page URLs in every published language. Ended events are returned flagged ended: true with their dates, never presented as upcoming. Look the event up by the id return
